title: bh-audit-schema: An Open Audit Event Standard for Behavioral Health Systems
description:
An open, versioned JSON Schema standard for behavioral health audit events, with a FHIR R5 AuditEvent profile and reference translator. PHI-minimizing by construction and mapped to HIPAA Security Rule, 42 CFR Part 2, and SOC 2 control objectives.

Version 2.0 adds a three-role attribution model (authenticating, acting, authorizing) that makes AI agent-mediated access to patient records attributable, with validation that rejects an unattributed agent action by construction.

Documented in Technical Reports BHOS-TR-2026-01 and BHOS-TR-2026-03, linked below.
